briefTitle: Open-Label Study of BBO-10203 in Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) 0-1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) 0-1

typedChecks.sourceText: Patients with untreated and/or non-stable brain metastases
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Patients with untreated and/or non-stable brain metastases

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive advanced breast cancer (aBC), HR-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer, KRAS mutant advanced colorectal cancer (aCRC), or KRAS mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer (aNSCLC)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial enrolls multiple different tumor types and mutations across cohorts, and is not a simple single-stage or single-biomarker NSCLC check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 (except for HR-positive HER2-negative aBC where evaluable bone-only disease is permitted)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate LVEF assessed by ECHO or MUGA (BBO-10203 + Trastuzumab cohorts only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Adequate LVEF is not a typed lab cutoff kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with HER2-positive aBC: Must have had at least 2 prior lines of anti-HER2-directed therapy. Only 1 prior line is acceptable where there is no other regionally available standard of care (SoC)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior line requirements vary by cohort and have alternative conditions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Monotherapy Cohort patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative aBC, KRAS mutant aCRC or aNSCLC: Must have progression on, or disease recurrence after at least one line of SOC treatment or in the opinion of the investigator, would be unlikely to tolerate or derive clinically meaningful benefit from SoC therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior treatment and investigator judgment options are cohort-specific and subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant combination cohort patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative aBC: confirmed PIK3CA mutation, must have been treated with a CDK4/6i
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific multi-feature requirements cannot be captured by a single typed biomarker check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant + ribociclib combination cohort patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative aBC: confirmed PIK3CA mutation, no prior systemic therapy in the aBC setting permitted
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific multi-feature requirements cannot be captured by a single typed biomarker check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: BBO-10203 + FOLFOX + Bevacizumab combination cohort patients with KRAS mutant aCRC: One prior line of irinotecan-containing therapy for locally advanced or metastatic CRC is allowed but not required
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific prior therapy rule is optional and specific to CRC.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with KRAS mutant aCRC who have KRAS G12R mutation, BRAFV600E mutation, HER2amp, or dMMR/MSI-H tumors
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion involves multiple specific mutations and tumor markers not covered by a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with KRAS mutant aNSCLC who have KRAS G12R mutation, or tumors with other targetable driver mutations (eg, EGFR, anaplastic lymphoma kinase, ROS1/BRAF/RET/MET/EGFR exon20 insertion/NTRK/HER2)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion includes a complex list of multiple excluded driver mutations.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive advanced breast cancer (aBC), HR-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer, KRAS mutant advanced colorectal cancer (aCRC), or KRAS mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer (aNSCLC)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Multiple distinct cancer cohorts with different biomarker/histology criteria are combined, making a single typed check insufficient.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 (except for HR-positive HER2-negative aBC where evaluable bone-only disease is permitted)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate LVEF assessed by ECHO or MUGA (BBO-10203 + Trastuzumab cohorts only)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: LVEF is not one of the allowed lab/organ function kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with HER2-positive aBC: Must have had at least 2 prior lines of anti-HER2-directed therapy. Only 1 prior line is acceptable where there is no other regionally available standard of care (SoC)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior line requirements differ by cohort and include conditional exceptions, which cannot be expressed as a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with KRAS mutant aCRC who have KRAS G12R mutation, BRAFV600E mutation, HER2amp, or dMMR/MSI-H tumors
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This exclusion rule covers multiple biomarkers and mutations that do not fit a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with KRAS mutant aNSCLC who have KRAS G12R mutation, or tumors with other targetable driver mutations (eg, EGFR, anaplastic lymphoma kinase, ROS1/BRAF/RET/MET/EGFR exon20 insertion/NTRK/HER2)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This exclusion rule covers multiple targetable driver mutations and a specific KRAS variant, which cannot be expressed as a single typed check.
